mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_consumed_message ( consumer_name, message_id, event_type, aggregate_id, consumed_at ) VALUES ( #{consumerName}, #{messageId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateId}, COALESCE(#{consumedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) ON CONFLICT (consumer_name, message_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO order_statistics ( id, created_count, paid_count, cancelled_count, created_amount, last_event_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'ORDER_CREATED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'ORDER_PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'ORDER_CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'ORDER_CREATED' THEN COALESCE(#{totalAmount}, 0) ELSE 0 END, #{occurredAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET created_count = order_statistics.created_count + EXCLUDED.created_count, paid_count = order_statistics.paid_count + EXCLUDED.paid_count, cancelled_count = order_statistics.cancelled_count + EXCLUDED.cancelled_count, created_amount = order_statistics.created_amount + EXCLUDED.created_amount, last_event_at = CASE WHEN order_statistics.last_event_at IS NULL THEN EXCLUDED.last_event_at ELSE GREATEST(order_statistics.last_event_at, EXCLUDED.last_event_at) END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
